dashboard.label: Mes droits
dashboard.description: Droits effectifs de l'utilisateur connecté : rôles, index cherchables, apps, capacités.

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | fields username realname roles capabilities defaultApp tz | eval roles_txt=mvjoin(roles, ", "), nb_caps=mvcount(capabilities)
| eventcount summarize=false index=* index=_* | stats sum(count) as evenements values(server) as serveurs by index | eval type=if(match(index, "^_"), "interne", "données")

| rest splunk_server=local /services/apps/local count=0 | search disabled=0 | rename eai:acl.can_write as can_write, eai:acl.perms.read as lecture, eai:acl.perms.write as ecriture, eai:acl.sharing as partage | eval acces=if(can_write="1" OR can_write="true", "lecture + écriture", "lecture"), visible=if(visible="1" OR visible="true", "oui", "non"), lecture=mvjoin(lecture, ", "), ecriture=mvjoin(ecriture, ", ") | table title label version acces visible lecture ecriture
| search visible="$f_visible$" acces="lecture + écriture" | stats count
| search type="$f_type$" | sort index | table index type evenements serveurs

| rest splunk_server=local /services/authorization/roles count=0 | search [| rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | fields roles | mvexpand roles | rename roles as title] | eval idx_autorises=mvdedup(mvappend(srchIndexesAllowed, imported_srchIndexesAllowed)), idx_defaut=mvdedup(mvappend(srchIndexesDefault, imported_srchIndexesDefault)), filtre=mvdedup(mvappend(srchFilter, imported_srchFilter)) | table title imported_roles idx_autorises idx_defaut filtre srchTimeWin srchJobsQuota rtSrchJobsQuota srchDiskQuota | rename title as role, imported_roles as herite_de, srchTimeWin as fenetre_max_s, srchJobsQuota as quota_jobs, rtSrchJobsQuota as quota_jobs_rt, srchDiskQuota as quota_disque_mo
| fields capabilities | mvexpand capabilities | rename capabilities as capacite | sort capacite
